title: Signatry SKILL.md frontmatter
description: Required and recognized YAML frontmatter fields for SKILL.md files in this repo. Loaded dynamically by skills/lint_skills.py so the field list can be edited here without touching the linter.

name.description: Kebab-case skill identifier. Should match the containing directory name.

description.description: Must clearly signal WHEN Claude should invoke this skill, not just what it contains (Anthropic guidance).

version.description: Semantic version of this skill package, e.g. 1.0 or 1.2.3.

release_date.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) this version was released.
